verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a startup back-office platform covering incorporation, registered agent, compliance, mailroom, accounting and tax. A document or contract vault is a plausible feature for this kind of product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no contract repository, contract search, or key-term or metadata extraction. The mailroom converts physical mail into viewable PDFs, but nothing indicates contract storage or term extraction, so this does not count.
